name: NATS
tagline: JetStream streams and consumers, with warnings when immutable fields drift.

features.title: Streams and consumers
features.body: Idempotent provisioning of JetStream streams and their consumers.

features.title: Strategy
features.body: update or create — globally or per stream.

features.title: Day durations
features.body: Durations accept Go syntax and day notation such as 7d.

features.title: Immutable field warnings
features.body: Warns on mismatched storage, retention, deny_delete and deny_purge.

features.title: Resilient and observable
features.body: Exponential backoff for NATS connectivity; structured JSON logs.
